collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: At a lively dinner a villager cannot think of anything to say: say the first thing that comes, or just listen.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At dinner everyone is talking: stories, jokes, the price of a good canoe. (subject) is sitting in the middle of it all, desperately trying to think of something to say. Anything. Every time (subject.he/she) thinks of something, the conversation has moved on. (subject.He/she) is starting to feel invisible, and stupid for feeling invisible.

choices.label: Say the First Thing That Comes

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) blurts out, "I saw a crab with one big claw today." There's a pause. Then someone says, "Oh! I've seen those! Do you know why?" and the conversation is suddenly about crabs, and (subject) is in the middle of it. It wasn't clever. It worked anyway.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) gives up trying and just listens. It's actually quite pleasant. After dinner, (friend) says, "You were quiet tonight. I like sitting next to you. It's restful." (subject) didn't know that being quiet could be something someone liked. (subject.He/she) thinks about it for days.
